responsibility: Collects general-purpose libc wrappers exported to GNU Modula-2 code in the mc bootstrap library. This file owns Modula-2-callable entry points for common POSIX and C runtime services including file I/O, process termination, perror, string and memory routines, time functions, environment access, file creation/open/seek, process ID and sleep, atexit registration, and printf/snprintf adapters that translate Modula-2-style backslash escapes before forwarding to stdio varargs functions.
